facts: Thonk states that WQP-made WQP518MA, PJ398SM and PJ301M-12 are functionally interchangeable; the old and new tab shapes differ.
Reference drawing rates the jack at DC 30 V, 0.5 A, with contact resistance at most 0.03 ohm, 3 to 25 N insertion/extraction force and 5,000 cycles.
Open CASCADE imports the saved STEP as five valid solids. See model-validation.json. CAD solidity is not proof of physical fit.

AudioJacks README marks the repository unfinished; DATA.md marks PJ398SM untested and suggests AudioJack3 instead of the required switched mono symbol. Use the contact drawing rather than that symbol hint.
gaps: The exact JLC row manufacturer, source, stock mode and accepted revision remain unresolved. Neither this drawing nor the community model establishes an exact JLC match.
Model dimensions and origin require a full audit before footprint use; mechanical and tolerance fit remains unqualified.
